blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (Caap) on Friday issued a Notice to Airmen (Notam) for flights near Mayon Volcano in Albay. This came after Mayon recorded a moderately explosive eruption earlier this Friday, sending a grayish ash plume 3,000 meters above the volcano. READ: Mayon Volcano erupts, sends ash plume 3,000 meters high In its advisory, Caap said the Notam will cover flights near Mayon with vertical limits extending from the surface up to 19,000 feet.
